title: The road to five islands.
subtitle: Stompy Acres · Release director’s board
healthNote: Roster locked. December 1 stays at risk until Fernlands and the production pace are proved.

northStar: Build a sanctuary full of dinosaurs you can’t believe you got.

milestones.title: Prove the foundations
milestones.outcome: Roster locked Oct 18. By Oct 25: Fernlands phone slice, first production samples and a credible remaining-work forecast; revenue/device choices settled.
milestones.gate: Oct 25: if slice or measured capacity misses, stop optional work and present resources/date tradeoffs. Keep the locked 40 unless Frozair changes scope.

milestones.title: Connect all five
milestones.outcome: All five persistent loops and normal-access unlocks; final roster data seeded with safe ownership/egg transitions. Art completion continues to Nov 8.
milestones.gate: All five are playable; first integration is not final art acceptance.

milestones.title: Finish the world
milestones.outcome: All 40 residents: required movement/actions/reveals, five habitats and expansion stages accepted. Freeze new features and content.
milestones.gate: Nov 8: both platforms pass the five-island walkthrough. Cut optional features first; any roster/date change needs Frozair.

milestones.title: Play it for a week
milestones.outcome: Seven days of signed beta observations, device checks and recovery evidence.
milestones.gate: Fresh/returning players, both OSes, offline/retry/recovery and supported-device endurance pass.

milestones.title: Submit, then stabilise
milestones.outcome: Public submissions Nov 16. Resolve store feedback and release defects.
milestones.gate: Public Apple + Google review, not just TestFlight/Play Internal. Approval timing is external.

milestones.title: Open the sanctuary
milestones.outcome: Five accepted islands. Approved public builds. Recovery and monitoring ready.
milestones.gate: Launch only when gates are green. Never trade save safety or a complete island for the date.

work.title: Put Fernlands on a phone
work.why: The locked fifth island has no runtime destination. Four transferred species are still assigned to Forest.
work.doneWhen: By Oct 25, existing-bank native slice persists through relaunch; test existing owners and ready eggs. By Nov 1, all five loops and normal-access routes work; final tuning requires approval.

work.title: Benchmark the 19 missing packages
work.why: 21 committed ranch banks exist; 19 do not. Time one full Iguanodon package and bounded Titanoboa/Mammoth motion proofs; define Swamp’s launch water presentation early.
work.doneWhen: Log time, rework and accepted full-package output. Recalculate packages remaining / days left to Nov 8, plus existing-bank/world/data work. Today’s floor is ~6.3/week; if only three finish by Oct 25, the remaining 16 need ~8/week. No sustainable pace is proven yet.

work.title: Turn the locked cast into game data
work.why: Only 10/40 are obtainable in their intended homes; 14/40 exist as obtainable species anywhere. Rarity/tier rules and normal unlock bills remain open.
work.doneWhen: One 40-row roster maps IDs, island, tier, bank/reveal, voice and behavior. Seed shops/Book/eggs/fixtures after approval; rehearse transfers and rollback without loss of owned specimens, eggs or pity.

work.title: See what alpha players do
work.why: Build 706 Android ingestion and four alpha dashboard insights are verified (#45 Done). Broader coverage is tracked in #60.
work.doneWhen: Review QA-excluded cohorts as time elapses; add observed progression, pacing and pity coverage. Empty charts do not establish retention.

work.title: Qualify current banks and finish motion faults
work.why: Para and Kentro are committed. #52 source sequencing fixes are committed; old Rex actions, bridge art and native acceptance remain.
work.doneWhen: Accept affected source motion and renderer joins; record exact native build evidence when build work is authorized. Do not reopen completed Para work or call build 706 proof of newer fixes.

work.title: Prove recovery before adding more content
work.why: Historical hosted backup/restore, crash receipt and staging capacity evidence is incomplete. Discover limits this week.
work.doneWhen: Confirm backup configuration, crash alert receipt and minimum-device baseline Oct 25; isolated hosted restore and load rehearsal by Nov 1.

work.title: Connect Treasure to the next island
work.why: Current two-island models do not validate the launch-five chain.
work.doneWhen: Select bills/offline policy by Oct 25; then implement, simulate ordinary attendance/RNG tails and playtest normal-access routes by Nov 1. Recipes unlock after Giants.

work.title: Finish the five island casts + worlds
work.why: 19 residents have no committed ranch bank. The existing 21 also need selected-look, action, reveal and integration checks. Five worlds must support the locked cast and all expansion stages.
work.doneWhen: All 40 pass movement/actions, hatch/reveal, variants, eggs, Book, voice coverage and their island expansion stages. Measure complete accepted output, including rework; escalate any capacity/date conflict without automatic roster cuts.

work.title: Prove phone performance + recovery
work.why: Older debug captures cannot certify the final release build.
work.doneWhen: First backup/monitoring and device baseline by Oct 25; isolated hosted restore and staging load by Nov 1; final candidate recovery/endurance regression by Nov 15.

work.title: Start the public-store checklist
work.why: Age/privacy decisions, listing assets and public review can block an otherwise finished game.
work.doneWhen: Resolve project’s audience/sign-in requirement, align disclosures, finish assets and submit both public builds Nov 16.

work.title: Sky after the first five
work.why: Frozair prefers Sky to Water. Flying routes add a separate production/motion problem.
work.doneWhen: Choose next-island scope after the five-island release is stable.

decisions.title: The 40 and their homes are locked
decisions.recommendation: Frozair approved the complete five-island roster. Iguanodon and Brachio are in Fernlands; the revised Snow eight are fixed. Casting is complete; final art and native acceptance remain.

decisions.title: What does each island require?
decisions.recommendation: Keep coins + found Treasure direction. Choose exact normal-access gates, resource bills and offline policy together; rare mutations stay optional.

decisions.title: Paid launch or free launch?
decisions.recommendation: Choose one small, proven purchase loop only if it fits. Otherwise launch free and schedule monetisation next. Full pass/catalog is a proposed deferral.

decisions.title: Which phones do we promise?
decisions.recommendation: Choose the minimum iPhone and Android models and measurable memory/loading/heat limits before committing more art.

decisions.title: Does the measured pace fit Nov 8?
decisions.recommendation: Compare accepted full packages and world/data work with remaining capacity. If the forecast misses, remove optional features first, then ask Frozair to choose resources/date tradeoffs. Do not silently cut residents.

risks.title: 19 new banks plus qualification
risks.action: The Oct 18 source audit found 21 committed ranch banks and 19 missing. A full package also needs movement/actions, reveal, integration, variants and phone evidence. Across 21 days to Nov 8, the new-bank floor is about 6.3/week before rework and world/data work. Measure accepted output by Oct 25; escalate any shortfall.

risks.title: Unproven body types and wetland behavior
risks.action: Prove Mammoth weight, Titanoboa continuous motion and aquatic residents’ water access early. Validate 16 residents, duplicate mixes and service clearance; still concepts are insufficient.

risks.title: Fernlands is not integrated
risks.action: Native slice by Oct 25; complete loop by Nov 1. Keep Water out of the release promise.

risks.title: Progression still unproved
risks.action: Model the selected five with ordinary attendance and unlucky tails; confirm with players.

risks.title: Public review is external
risks.action: Start setup now; submit Nov 16 and protect the final fortnight for fixes.

risks.title: Recovery is not yet proven
risks.action: Recheck dated backup/monitoring gaps now. Initial proof Oct 25, hosted isolated restore and staging load Nov 1; final regression Nov 15.

risks.title: Species moves affect existing saves
risks.action: Rex, Trike, Anky and Brachio still have Forest as their data home. Rehearse species/egg/Book/production/storehouse transitions and rollback before any rollout. Roster approval does not authorize a reset.

launchGates.label: Five meaningful islands
launchGates.proof: Eight accepted species per island, 40 total. Each island: unlock, arrival, shop, hatch/reveal, work, collect/sell, every expansion, Book and offline return.

launchGates.label: Understandable progression
launchGates.proof: Fresh-player and ordinary-return observations; credible normal-dino gate route, no ultra-rare requirement. Exact values approved.

launchGates.label: Stable release phones
launchGates.proof: Both OSes, minimum supported devices, repeated travel/hatch/shop, 16 residents/duplicate variants, endurance and retry cases pass agreed limits.

launchGates.label: Saves + operations
launchGates.proof: Update/reinstall/account-link recovery, hosted backup and isolated restore, crash receipt, load/rollback evidence. No known critical data or duplication faults.

launchGates.label: Both stores approved
launchGates.proof: Public approvals for the exact candidates; listings, disclosures, audience/deletion path and any paid receipt/odds flows complete.

launchGates.label: Director acceptance
launchGates.proof: Frozair approves island readability, motion, reveal delight and collection identity from final native play.

deferred.title: Water / Lagoon
deferred.reason: Excluded by Frozair from the release five; existing destination needs an explicit visibility policy before 1.0. No deletion or reset is authorised.

deferred.title: Sky, Riverbend and extra islands
deferred.reason: Sky is Frozair’s preferred future candidate. Finish and stabilise five first.

deferred.title: Full season pass + broad premium catalog
deferred.reason: Proposed cut pending Oct 25 revenue decision. One validated paid loop is the maximum recommendation.

deferred.title: New hybrids, decor and art rewrites
deferred.reason: Proposed postlaunch work unless needed to fix a demonstrated launch-blocking defect.

changes.text: Frozair locked all 40 species and island homes. Casting review closed. Fresh source audit: 21 committed ranch banks, 19 missing; 14/40 obtainable anywhere, 10/40 in intended homes. Para/Kentro are committed; Dilophosaurus has banks. Fernlands phone slice and production benchmark lead the updated plan.

Recommended habitat revision: Iguanodon → greener Fernlands; Nanuqsaurus, Prince Creek Edmontosaurus, Leaellynasaura and Woolly Rhinoceros proposed for Snow. Borealopelta, Cryolophosaurus, Citipati and Concavenator benched in this proposal. Eight per island/40 total and all milestone dates stay; no game data changes.
Frozair superseded 28 with 40 launch species: eight per island. Brachio → Fernlands; Paraceratherium out. Supporting moves remain proposals. Dates stay; capacity must be proved.
Analytics #45 Done: build 706 Android ingestion and four alpha dashboard insights verified. Coverage follow-up is #60; retention needs elapsed, non-QA cohorts.
Superseded: Frozair initially approved 28 species and reviewed 28 picks + 12 alternates. The later eight-per-island decision sets launch scope to 40.
Frozair confirmed Forest, Giants, Swamp, Snow and Fernlands; Water excluded, Sky preferred for the future. Daily sole focus confirmed.

evidence.label: Baseline
evidence.detail: Production handoff, Oct 18: alpha 0.1.6 build 706 distributed to TestFlight internal and Play Internal. Reused reported evidence; this roadmap did not reinstall or certify a build.

evidence.label: Concepts vs runtime
evidence.detail: Latest board #23–30, #42, #49–51; accepted concepts do not establish completed runtime art, roster data or launch readiness.

evidence.label: Release limits
evidence.detail: docs/release-security.md; docs/posthog-rollout.md; fastlane/Fastfile. Historical check counts and internal distribution do not establish public-store approval or current operational readiness.

evidence.label: Analytics rollout
evidence.detail: Latest #45 is Done: native Android build 706 → server → PostHog ingestion, retry dedup and four saved alpha insights verified. QA is excluded; empty non-QA charts are not retention results. #60 owns missing coverage.

evidence.label: Current source audit · Oct 18
evidence.detail: HEAD 86ce6020 plus preserved unrelated local work. DinoBanks/Look and committed ranch assets: 21/40 banks. SQL/shop rows: 17 obtainable overall, 14 locked residents anywhere, 10 in approved homes; no Fernlands runtime/server destination. No new build was installed by this review.

evidence.label: Completed art updates
evidence.detail: Para c0c582f9 and follow-up reproducibility fix committed; #50 Done. Kentro 840c9400 committed/routed. Dilophosaurus committed ranch/reveal banks exist; selected-look match still needs review. Local Gallimimus/Rex changes are not claimed shipped.

evidence.label: Capacity calculation
evidence.detail: 19 missing ranch banks / 21 calendar days (Oct 18 → Nov 8) × 7 ≈ 6.3 new packages/week minimum. Existing-bank and reveal checks, final selected looks, worlds, data and device evidence are additional. This is a planning requirement, not a measured production rate.

evidence.label: Approved roster and habitat
evidence.detail: Explicit Frozair approval Oct 18 locks the revised 40 and all homes. Snow: seasonal woodland/stream edges/open forage; five stronger cold/polar fits and three conditional (Yuty/Sino/Lea). Original sources and uncertainty remain on the roster page.

firstWork.title: Start with the fifth island.
firstWork.note: Engine and art can move together. Clear these proofs before scaling up production; store and recovery work starts in parallel.

items.title: Make Fernlands playable
items.outcome: Arrive → buy → hatch → work → sell → expand → relaunch. Start with an existing bank; rehearse the four species moves without losing owned dinos or ready eggs.

items.title: Prove the creature pipeline
items.outcome: Time one full Iguanodon package through motion, work, reveal and phone review. Use bounded Titanoboa/Mammoth samples to expose body risks; forecast from measured rework and days left.

items.title: Protect progression and saves
items.outcome: Set the five-island unlock ladder and device floor; confirm backup/crash receipt and begin public-store setup. Review the capacity forecast on Oct 25.

production.title: 40 residents. Here is the production gap.
production.note: Dot = committed ranch bank found; diamond = no bank yet. Both still need selected-look, action, reveal, data and phone checks. 20 dedicated reveals exist; Stegouros uses a one-frame fallback to review. These are source counts, not a finished-work percentage.

residents.name: Titanoboa

residents.name: Yutyrannus
residents.detail: Existing committed ranch/reveal is a starting point. Selected periwinkle concept is separate; appearance matching and Snow seasonal woodland habitat proof remain. Cannot certify portrait as production-ready from bank existence.

residents.name: Pachyrhinosaurus
residents.detail: Existing concept is unchanged and needs a P. perotorum reference check before production acceptance. Preserve its nasal boss; a shaggy coat is not directly established.

residents.name: Woolly Mammoth
residents.detail: Strong cold-climate fit; a production stretch. Prove trunk and tusk continuity early; accessible forage remains necessary.

residents.name: Sinosauropteryx
residents.detail: Long tail and feather cues need phone-size readability checks.

residents.name: Nanuqsaurus
residents.detail: New concept is unapproved. Feathering is an artistic inference; no direct Nanuqsaurus plumage fossil is known. Its adult size remains under reassessment. No production bank or qualification is claimed.

residents.name: Edmontosaurus
residents.detail: New concept is unapproved and refers to Prince Creek Edmontosaurus sp.; species identity is unresolved. No production bank or qualification is claimed.

residents.name: Leaellynasaura
residents.detail: New concept is unapproved. Its polar-forest context is better established than its complete anatomy or behaviour; some referred remains are uncertain. No production bank or qualification is claimed.

residents.name: Woolly Rhinoceros
residents.detail: New concept is unapproved. This is a cold-adapted mammal, like the existing mammoth; it needs exposed forage. No production bank or qualification is claimed.

residents.name: Rex
residents.detail: Ranch routes RexDino through split recorded actions+gait with rex_motion enabled. Generic panels keep painted sheet. Dedicated reveal currently has local changes beyond HEAD; preserve active reveal work and qualify final output.

residents.name: Trike
residents.detail: Preserve the original blue Trike. Current runtime is a separate production asset.

residents.name: Ankylosaurus
residents.detail: Latest working Fernlands assignment replaces Heterodontosaurus; use original green identity.

residents.name: Stegosaurus
residents.detail: New animation package required; compare broad plates with Forest Kentrosaurus and Stegouros.

residents.name: Iguanodon
residents.detail: Existing accepted concept is unchanged. Fernlands suits the documented plant-rich settings better than a Snow-first placement; habitat flexibility and production readiness remain separate questions.

residents.name: Brachio
residents.detail: Selected softer-smile concept. Existing Brachio bank remains a separate production asset.

residents.name: Microraptor
residents.detail: Grounded scope only. Hindwing and fan-tail clearance need work; no flight mechanic selected.

residents.name: Anzu
